node.title: Trim receiver-colour profiles to lower-bound complete core bases
node.statement: For a complete joint core of size>=M in a fixed polynomial carrier, full local-core fibre contraction and any proved monotone child basis bound F give B_s>=min sum x_i F(K-w_i), 0<=x_i<=w_i, sum x_i=M, evaluated by largest-class-first trimming. Heavy coordinate mass<=E in classes>c gives (M-E)F(K-c)+E F(K-E), for1<=c<=E<=K-s+1. This is a lower relaxation, not profile realizability or an MCA payment.
